summary: Verified duplicate camera bug fix via code review. The fix implements: (1) CSS hiding of Match video layer during game mode via opacity:0/visibility:hidden, (2) JS clearing of srcObject on Match video refs when game is active, (3) Proper stream reattachment when game ends. Live two-user testing not possible in single-session environment.
critical_code_review_comments: Match.js Lines 133-166: New useEffect handles video srcObject management based on isGameActive state
Match.js Lines 138-149: When isGameActive=true, pauses and clears srcObject on both localVideoRef and remoteVideoRef - prevents duplicate video rendering
Match.js Lines 152-165: When isGameActive=false, reattaches localStream and remoteStream to video refs - restores normal camera view
match.css Lines 1281-1282: .match-videos--game-mode has opacity:0 and visibility:hidden - hides Match video layer during game mode
Match.js Line 758: Conditional class application: match-videos--game-mode added when isGameActive is true
Match.js Lines 176-186: resetAllGameState sets activeGame=null, triggering stream reattachment via useEffect
Match.js Lines 642-648: handleSkip calls resetAllGameState() before skipMatch() - ensures clean camera restoration
Game components (UnoGame, FeudGame, DrawGame) create their own video elements using localStream/remoteStream props - these are the ONLY visible cameras during game mode
context_for_next_testing_agent: Duplicate camera bug fix verified via code review. The fix ensures only one camera per user during game mode by: (1) hiding Match video layer with CSS, (2) clearing srcObject on Match video refs, (3) game components render their own video elements. Camera restoration after skip/game change works via resetAllGameState() which sets activeGame=null, triggering the useEffect to reattach streams. ESLint passes on Match.js.

match_video_srcobject_cleared_during_gam.details: Match.js useEffect (Lines 138-149) clears srcObject on localVideoRef and remoteVideoRef when isGameActive=true

camera_restoration_after_game_exit.details: Match.js useEffect (Lines 152-165) reattaches streams when isGameActive=false

camera_restoration_after_skip.details: handleSkip (Line 644) calls resetAllGameState() which sets activeGame=null, triggering stream reattachment

only_one_camera_per_user_in_game_mode.details: Game components (UnoGame, FeudGame, DrawGame) create their own video elements; Match video layer is hidden

testing_limitations: Live two-user game switching testing not possible - requires WebSocket connection between two browser sessions. Code-level verification confirms fix is correct based on CSS hiding and srcObject management logic.

bug_fix_verification.original_issue: Duplicate cameras visible during game mode
bug_fix_verification.root_cause: Match.js video layer remained visible alongside game component video elements

match_js: useEffect clears srcObject on video refs when isGameActive=true (Lines 138-149)

expected_behavior.game_active: Match video layer hidden (CSS), srcObject cleared (JS), only game component cameras visible
expected_behavior.game_exit: activeGame set to null, useEffect reattaches streams, Match video layer visible again
expected_behavior.skip_during_game: resetAllGameState() clears activeGame, streams reattach, then skipMatch() finds new match
